content: Hi how can i assist you today
My driving app flashes 'slow down' right as I think it. Feels responsive.
Speed alerts often trigger at set thresholds or near known enforcement zones. Were you passing a common camera or school area?
Those zones have timed alerts. The coincidence can feel personal because the warning and your thought arrive together.
On weekends I rarely get that alert.
That’s consistent with how these alerts work.
